quieter.line: Every day that comes, the echo of you living here gets quieter
stanza: Every day that comes, the echo of you living here gets quieter
Obscured by the loud wind of us now wailing and moaning for you
But also living, talking about school, making food, or just surviving and still…
Waking up again, the baby that you knew is now a kid
And when she looks at me with your eyes, the shape of almonds, I am stirred ins…
